title: Every tenant table has direct-filter RLS on org_id
description: RLS coverage invariant — every ORG-scoped tenant table has rowsecurity=true AND ≥1 policy filtering on org_id (per Q10b child-entity scope-axis rule). USER-scoped child tables have rowsecurity=true AND ≥1 policy filtering on parent FK. Defense-in-depth for SOC2 CC6.1 (Logical access). When introspection surface unavailable (current state on main HEAD), the rule SKIPs cleanly. Wave 1.1+ adds /api/_introspect/rls-coverage that queries pg_policies + pg_tables and reports any tenant-classified table without RLS or without the proper org_id filter pattern as FAIL.
source: F1-Wave-B Plan B-1b nwrp152 + nwrp153 Q9 D
